# Alaska AI

> Alaska AI is the daily publication on Alaska's AI beat and an AI studio in
> Anchorage that builds AI systems for Alaska businesses. Every fact on the
> site is verified against a fetched primary source, and every deck page
> publishes that verification record with the claim, the outlet, the date,
> and whether the source is a primary document.

Content here may be read, indexed and cited by AI systems. Attribution to
Alaska AI with a link to the page is requested. No crawler is blocked.

## Core pages

- [AI consulting for Alaska businesses](https://alaskaaihq.com/services/)
- [The Bottleneck Scanner, an honest free read of where AI would and would not help a business](https://alaskaaihq.com/scan/)
- [The Alaska AI Docket, every AI infrastructure decision in the state](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/)
- [Cook Inlet Gas Watch, the daily numeric record of Southcentral Alaska's natural gas position](https://alaskaaihq.com/gas-watch/) measured storage, modeled demand, and a derived non CINGSA supply figure published nowhere else. It states no verdict on supply adequacy
- [Questions, answered from the tracked record](https://alaskaaihq.com/questions/) which comment windows are open, who decides, where the projects are
- [Articles, one verified Alaska and AI story a day](https://alaskaaihq.com/archive/)
- [About Alaska AI](https://alaskaaihq.com/about/)

## Feeds

- [Articles, RSS](https://alaskaaihq.com/feed.xml) full content, one deck a day
- [Articles, Atom](https://alaskaaihq.com/atom.xml)
- [Articles, JSON Feed](https://alaskaaihq.com/feed.json)
- [Docket changes, RSS](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/feed.xml) every tracked Alaska AI decision as it moves

## Data

- [The data, schema, license and how to use it](https://alaskaaihq.com/data/) start here if you want to build on or quote the docket
- [The docket as open JSON](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket.json) versioned, CC BY 4.0, field documentation travels with the data
- [Cook Inlet Gas Watch as open JSON](https://alaskaaihq.com/gas-watch.json) one object per day, CC BY 4.0, every record carries the model that produced it and the provenance of every fetch behind it. 24 days on record, 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-28
- [Every article as plain Markdown, one fetch](https://alaskaaihq.com/llms-full.txt)
- [The source archive, every document a claim was verified against](https://alaskaaihq.com/sources/)

## Tracked decisions

One page per decision, each with the deciding body, the dates that
matter, whether the public has a way in, a source for every fact,
and a dated history of how it moved.

- [STAK Energy's North Slope AI campus lease](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/adl-422741-stak-north-slope-lease/) Alaska DNR, Division of Oil and Gas. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [Air Force land leases for AI data centers at JBER, Eielson and Clear](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/air-force-eul-ai-data-centers/) Department of the Air Force, Enhanced Use Lease program. Updated 2026-08-29.
- [GVEA's $120 million turbine decision](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/gvea-lm6000-turbine-purchase/) Golden Valley Electric Association board of directors. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [The AKLNG gas line tax bill](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/aklng-tax-bill-second-special-session/) Alaska Legislature, third special session. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [Enstar's Cook Inlet gas storage plan (Kenai Loop Pool)](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/enstar-cook-inlet-gas-storage/) Regulatory Commission of Alaska (prudency); Alaska DNR (storage lease and technical determination). Updated 2026-08-26.
- [AIDEA's free state land for a Mat-Su data center park](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/aidea-houston-industrial-park/) Alaska DNR, Commissioner John Crowther. Updated 2026-08-29.
- [Anchorage data-center zoning ordinance AO 2026-27](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/anchorage-ao-2026-27-data-center-zoning/) Anchorage Assembly. Updated 2026-08-19.
- [HB 259, state utility standards for large data centers](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/hb-259-data-center-utility-standards/) Alaska Legislature (House Energy Committee). Updated 2026-08-26.
- [The AI ratepayer pledge, and which Alaska utilities have signed it](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/ratepayer-protection-pledge-alaska-utilities/) Each Alaska electric utility board, including the Railbelt cooperatives. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [Alaska's statewide speech-to-text contract](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/alaska-statewide-transcription-rfp/) Alaska Department of Administration, Office of Procurement and Property Management. Updated 2026-08-28.
- [DMV asks vendors about automated compliance for commercial licenses](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/dmv-automated-compliance-rfi/) Alaska Department of Administration, Division of Motor Vehicles. Updated 2026-08-29.
- [The Dixon Glacier diversion into Bradley Lake](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/bradley-lake-dixon-diversion/) Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. Updated 2026-08-28.
- [A national AI institute for Native communities, and the Alaska lane that closed with it](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/ana-ai3-action-institute/) Administration for Native Americans, HHS Administration for Children and Families. Updated 2026-08-27.
- [The Air Force nuclear microreactor at Eielson](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/eielson-oklo-microreactor/) Department of the Air Force with Defense Logistics Agency Energy, and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission for the license. Updated 2026-08-29.
- [The Army's Janus microreactor program at Fort Wainwright](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/army-janus-fort-wainwright/) Department of the Army, running its solicitation through the Defense Innovation Unit. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [Copper Valley Electric's shelved nuclear reactor study](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/cvea-micro-modular-reactor/) Copper Valley Electric Association board. Updated 2026-08-06.
- [The executive order that lets big data centers skip the usual federal review](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/eo-14318-data-center-permitting/) The President, carried out by the Council on Environmental Quality and the Interior, Energy and Defense departments. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [An 89 million dollar federal grant for a coal plant in the Susitna watershed](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/terra-energy-center-doe-grant/) U.S. Department of Energy made the selection; the plant itself needs state and federal permits nobody has applied for yet. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [Alaska's bid to run its own carbon storage permits](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/aogcc-class-vi-carbon-storage/) Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission applies; the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency decides. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [The Kenai Peninsula school district's AI rulebook](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/kpbsd-ai-policy-package/) Kenai Peninsula Borough School District Board of Education. Updated 2026-08-26.
- [DeepGreen's underwater data center in Cook Inlet](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/deepgreen-cook-inlet-subsea-data-center/) Federal Energy Regulatory Commission. Updated 2026-08-29.
- [Anchorage's surveillance rules for its police crime center](https://alaskaaihq.com/docket/anchorage-rtcc-surveillance-ordinance/) Anchorage Assembly. Updated 2026-08-29.

## Standing beats

These pages are permanent. Each stays live whether or not the beat
made news this week.

- [Data centers](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/data-centers/) Every proposed AI and cloud campus in Alaska, the land it wants, the power it needs, and who gets to say yes. 13 articles.
- [Power and the grid](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/power-and-the-grid/) The Railbelt, Cook Inlet gas, the turbines and the interties. Who pays when a new load the size of a city plugs in. 18 articles.
- [Land and permitting](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/land-and-permitting/) State land leases, gravel, permafrost and the public comment windows that are the only door most Alaskans get. 21 articles.
- [Defense and federal](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/defense-and-federal/) JBER, Eielson, Clear and the federal decisions that land in Alaska without an Alaska vote. 21 articles.
- [Research and science](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/research-and-science/) The university labs, the agencies and the field science using machine learning on Alaska problems. 19 articles.
- [Data sovereignty](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/data-sovereignty/) Who owns Alaska data, who trains on it, and the Native corporations and tribes setting terms. 6 articles.
- [State policy](https://alaskaaihq.com/topics/state-policy/) Bills, the governor's desk, the regulatory commission and everything that decides the rules before the concrete pours. 22 articles.
